accessible_via.return: db, gene_product_id, gene_product_symbol, gene_product_name, gene_product_type, qualifier, go_id, db_reference, evidence, with, aspect, synonyms, taxon_id, date, assigned_by, annotation_extension, gene_product_form_id, organism, source, source_url, name, inverse_name, class, method, label, files_filesets

_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the source GAF annotation record together with the gene product handle.

db.description: Database the annotated gene product identifier is drawn from.

gene_product_id.description: Identifier of the annotated gene product in that database.

gene_product_symbol.description: Symbol of the annotated gene or gene product.

gene_product_name.description: Full name of the annotated gene or gene product.

gene_product_type.description: Class of biological entity of the annotated identifier.

qualifier.description: Relation Ontology predicate describing how the gene product relates to the GO term. Negation is written as NOT followed by the relation, pipe-separated.

go_id.description: Gene Ontology identifier of the associated term.

db_reference.description: Identifiers of the reference cited as the source of the annotation.

evidence.description: GO evidence code supporting the annotation.

with.description: Additional identifiers supporting the evidence, used with certain evidence codes.

aspect.description: Branch of the Gene Ontology the term belongs to: P for biological process, F for molecular function, or C for cellular component.

synonyms.description: Alternate names the annotated gene or gene product.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomic identifiers of the species the gene product is found in.

date.description: Date the annotation was made, as YYYYMMDD.

annotation_extension.description: Further specification of the GO term using a Relation Ontology predicate and an additional entity.

gene_product_form_id.description: Identifier of a specific isoform or processed form when the annotation is more specific than the canonical gene product.
